notes_for_editor: Only the FFLA Minnesota list and the St. Louis County tower PDF were read; no DNR, NRHP or local-history source describing the site was found in search. The PDF has a second Eveleth row (tower 35, undated, marked 'First tower at this site') whose notes are laid out ambiguously in the text extraction, so the story uses only the tower 7 row. The 1947 table date is tied to a survey reference, not a confirmed build year, so no built event is recorded and no build year is stated. The county list coordinates (47.4878, -92.5339) and the directory's (47.48705, -92.53308) agree to about 100 m. Confidence is medium because the loss rests on one county note and the directory; no date or method for the destruction is given.
